list: Official trophy list as published by PlayStation (Exophase / PSNProfiles, agreeing on every name, description and grade). Guides are our own words, written for this entry, and cite their sources.

trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies. The platinum is the reward for the whole journey — about 200 hours at a relaxed pace, difficulty 4/10: long, not hard. Work the roadmap in order: story first, then strangers, collectibles and activities, robberies and money, and finally the 100% cleanup.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission 'Gone Fishing'. An early story mission that also teaches the fishing basics — just play through it and it unlocks naturally.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1 by playing its missions to the end. While you are still in Chapter 1, meditate at Lucia's balcony — that meditation spot disappears after the chapter, and it is the only missable step in the whole game (see Positive Mental Attitude).
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2 by playing its missions to the end. Story trophies unlock naturally as you follow the chapters — there are no difficulty trophies and no mission medals to worry about.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3 by playing its missions to the end. Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter — there is no mission replay and no New Game Plus, so a save per chapter is your safety net.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4 by playing its missions to the end. Bank vaults open up after an optional Chapter 4 mission — remember that for Maximum Withdrawal later.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission and finish the story. Before you start it, make a manual save — there is no mission replay, so a save before the finale lets you go back for anything you missed. The 100% checklist appears under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion after the story.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission 'Breakfast Run'. Mission trophies unlock by finishing the named mission — just play through it.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission 'The Cartel Heist'. Heist missions are story milestones — finish the mission and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission 'Child's Play'.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission 'Headliners'.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission 'VCIA Takedown' at Vice City International Airport.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission 'Operation Savage Glory'.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Attain 100% Completion. The checklist appears under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion after the story (earlier progress counts). It has 35 tasks, roughly 45% story and tasks, 45% exploration and activities, 10% discovery — and nothing on it is missable. The steepest requirements: 300 of 397 stunts, all 42 shooting-range golds, 100 WAiNK locations, 15 of 18 card sets, 70 of 80 challenges, 30 of 40 unique races won, all 42 drone time trials, and 200 of 277 vehicles discovered.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunts are stunt jumps (130 in the world), under-bridge flights (202), knife flights (40) and base jumps (25) — 397 in total, and any combination counts. The in-game stunt counter tracks your progress. For 100% completion you need 300.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. Play one of every activity type in Leonida — races, fishing, bowling, arcade games, shooting ranges, drone races and the rest. You do not need to win or finish them, just try each kind once.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges. There are 42 challenges: 18 at the Griffin range and 24 at Rodgers Ranch. Gold every one — take your time and learn each range's targets; a steady aim beats speed.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location. There are 14 Top Fun locations across Leonida — win one drone race at each. For 100% completion you also need all 42 drone time trials across those locations.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Road races, off-road, air and water all count — but replaying the same race does not add to the count; you need 20 distinct ones. For 100% completion you need 30 of 40 unique races won, plus 10 of 13 race challenge golds.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal and beat him at fishing. Fishing is an early activity — the 'Gone Fishing' mission teaches the basics, so this one is easy to pick up once you meet him.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Play an arcade game through to its end at any arcade in Leonida.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Finish Andy's stranger mission strand — play his missions as they appear across Leonida and complete his finale.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Finish Kenton's stranger mission strand and his finale.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Finish Billy's stranger mission strand and his finale.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. There are more than 8 stranger strands in the state — complete any 8. Strangers appear as '?' markers on the map; talk to them and follow their missions to the end.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Finish Randy's stranger mission strand and his finale.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Finish Tyrone's stranger mission strand and his finale.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. There are 18 meditation spots in 10 locations. THIS IS THE GAME'S ONLY POTENTIALLY MISSABLE TROPHY: Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 disappears after that chapter, so meditate there before you finish Chapter 1. Do it early — the rest of the spots stay available. Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter as a safety net.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Follow Bret's stranger strand — it leads you to hunt a unique animal. Take the shot when it appears.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. There are 18 card sets (480 cards total) hidden across Leonida — complete any 3 sets. Cards are found in the world; the cited guides map the sets. For 100% completion you need 15 of 18 sets.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Use the WAiNK feature at 100 different locations across Leonida. WAiNK also counts toward discovering vehicles, so scan as you travel — it does double duty for Whip It Good.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges come in 8 categories with 10 each (80 total) — complete any 50. For 100% completion you need 70 of 80.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Get a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then lose the cops together. Use fast cars, alleys and the subway to break line of sight.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Rob three shops in a row with your partner alongside, keeping your wanted level the whole time. Plan a route through three nearby shops and move fast between them.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Find and drive — or WAiNK-scan — 100 different vehicles. There are 277 base models; a WAiNK scan counts as discovering a vehicle. For 100% completion you need 200.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate Combat Focus with 5 enemies close together and drop all five before it ends. Pick a crowded fight and trigger it when enemies cluster.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. At Vice City International Airport, take off in a plane without following the scheduled departure — steal a plane and leave on your own terms.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: The description points at the Rhino tank, but no confirmed method has been published for this one yet — the cited guides list it as unconfirmed. Do not trust a walkthrough that claims a method without a source; check the sources for updates as players pin it down.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Get in and out with the goods and no alarm raised. Go at night, move quietly, and leave before anyone spots you.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. There are 8 bank vaults; rob any 5 and escape. Vaults open up after an optional Chapter 4 mission, and every vault robbery brings a 4-star wanted level — bring a fast bike for the getaway.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Find an armored truck on the road, rob it, and escape the police response.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Visit every region of the state. Drive, fly and walk the map — the trophy pops once you have covered all of Leonida's areas.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. Hit one illegal operation for every gang in Leonida. Scout the operations first, then rob each gang's in turn.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Order a cocktail at a bar overlooking Ocean Beach and take in the view — any beachfront bar with a view counts.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car straight through a vehicle showroom's window and out the other side.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Bowl a game at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley in Vice City.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: The description gives no clear method yet and no confirmed guide has pinned this one down — the cited sources list it as unconfirmed. Do not trust a walkthrough that claims a method without a source; check the sources for updates.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: This one is tied to choices you make in the story — it unlocks through a decision along the way, so it comes naturally as you play and choose. No confirmed detail has been published on which choice; check the sources for updates.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: The description hints at a second attempt succeeding — but no confirmed method has been published yet. The cited guides list it as unconfirmed; check them for updates rather than following an unsourced claim.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: No confirmed method has been published for this one as of 18 Nov — the cited guides list it as unconfirmed. Do not trust a walkthrough that claims a method without a source; check the sources for updates as players pin it down.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: The description suggests a melee drive-by at the bowling alley, but no confirmed method has been published yet — the cited guides list it as unconfirmed. Check the sources for updates rather than following an unsourced claim.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists — pass them through your contacts to clean them, and the counter tracks your total.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Spend $100,000 in total across the game's shops — clothes, weapons, vehicles and more all count toward the total.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Buy every garage property available in Leonida. Save up and buy them as they come on the market.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Register 10 vehicles you own or find to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.name: On the Spot
